subject: Crescent vendor registry: MSA staging & PO field gating preflight
messages:
From: Jordan Meyers <jordan@crescenthealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@crescenthealth.com
Date: 2027-04-11T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor registry kickoff and initial MSA questions

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Crescent is starting vendor enrollment for our new procurement portal (Ariba) and we want to run a short preflight on two things before we submit the registration: the MSA redline status and the PO field gating/ack rules so our sourcing team can map fields correctly.

Attached is our procurement spec (Crescent_Procurement_Prelim.xlsx) — it lists required PO attributes (billing_code, cost_center, po_type, ack_window) and some validation rules. Before we push your vendor record into Ariba we need confirmation on: 1) whether Redwood can accept our billing_code enum (4-digit numeric) or if we need to map via a custom field, and 2) whether you can honor a 72-hour PO acknowledgement window for initial suppliers.

Also: who on your side will own the order-form signature? We anticipate an MSA redline sent to legal and an order form executed via DocuSign.

Would appreciate a 20–30 minute preflight call this week. My calendar is open Wed/Thu morning PST.

Thanks,
Jordan
Vendor Enablement — Crescent Health
procurement@crescenthealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Crescent_Procurement_Prelim.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan@crescenthealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registry kickoff and initial MSA questions

Jordan — thanks for the spec and the clear asks. Glad to help. Quick responses inline and then a proposed next step.

1) MSA redline: legal is currently reviewing Crescent's changes. Ive attached the latest internal redline (redwood_msa_v3_redline.pdf) for transparency. Kimberly (ccd) is the lead on legal and will call out any non-standard commercial terms that require exec sign-off.

2) PO fields: our platform supports a custom "billing_code" mapping; we can accept a 4-digit numeric but it will be mapped into our canonical billing_code attribute (we'll sync the enum). Ack window: we can configure a 72-hour PO ack window for initial activation, but for long-term SLA we'd prefer 48 hours — we can make 72 hours a one-time onboarding exception. Marcus (ops) will own the portal mapping and SFTP integration.

Proposed next step: 30-minute preflight call tomorrow (Wed) 10:00–10:30 PT to walk through the sheet and confirm the order-form flow. I've included a short agenda below.

Agenda (30 min)
- Legal redline scope & timeline (Kimberly) — 10 min
- PO field mapping & examples (Marcus) — 10 min
- Activation timeline & SFTP/credentials handoff — 10 min

If that works I will send a calendar invite and drop the internal whiteboard notes to the HubSpot record. We will also prepare a redline summary and a proposed order-form template for DocuSign.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0124

Attachments: redwood_msa_v3_redline.pdf (PDF stub)
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Jordan Meyers <jordan@crescenthealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T08:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registry kickoff and initial MSA questions

Thanks — adding legal context and a short checklist.

High level: Crescent's redline contains three areas we routinely accept (data residency exceptions, IP carve-outs for derived telemetry, and very limited indemnity tweaks). The two commercial items that will need approval are: 1) liability cap changes above our standard threshold, and 2) a carve-out for third-party claims tied to customer-supplied data.

For the procurement mapping: Marcus and I reviewed the sheet and have two technical asks we need Crescent to confirm before portal activation:
- billing_code: confirm whether the 4-digit code is unique per site (yes/no). If not unique, we need the combination (billing_code + site_id) to avoid collisions.
- po_ack_window: if Crescent requires 72 hours for all suppliers, we need to document this as an onboarding exception and include it in the order form. Our standard is 48 hours and our monitoring/alerts are configured for that SLA.

I'll prepare a concise redline summary (msaredline_summary.md) with line-item references to the MSA and a suggested order-form clause for the ack window. Please confirm whether Crescent will sign the DocuSign order form with the onboarding exception spelled out.

Forwarding Rafael's invite once confirmed.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachment: msaredline_summary.md (text stub)

From: Jordan Meyers <jordan@crescenthealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@crescenthealth.com
Date: 2027-04-13T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registry kickoff and initial MSA questions

Kimberly / Rafael — thanks for the rapid review and clarity. We can confirm the following:

- billing_code will be unique per site; Crescent will include site_id in the export to avoid collisions.
- procurement is comfortable with the onboarding exception of a 72-hour ack window for initial suppliers; they will sign the order form reflecting that exception.

Next items from our side: we will attach the Ariba spec (Crescent_ariba_specs.pdf) and provide SFTP credentials for PO delivery once the DocuSign order form is in flight. Proposed timeline: complete legal redline review by EOD next Tue, sign order form by end of next week, portal activation the following week. Does that sequence match Redwoods activation flow?

Thanks — Jordan
Vendor Enablement — Crescent Health
jordan@crescenthealth.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Crescent_ariba_specs.pdf (PDF stub)
